sqlMap.select:
/*BudgetCommCd.selectList*/ SELECT B.GROUP_ID AS GROUP_ID , B.DETL_CD , B.DETL_CD_NM , B.LINE_UP_ORD
, '' AS GROUP_COL
, CASE WHEN INSTR(B.GROUP_ID, '|') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(B.GROUP_ID, 0, (INSTR(B.GROUP_ID, '|') - 1)) || '년 ' || (SELECT CASE WHEN C.BGT_COMPO_FG = '10' THEN '본예산' ELSE '추경' || C.ADD_TIMES || '차' END AS CODE_NM FROM TB_BGTDGR C WHERE fis_year = SUBSTR(B.GROUP_ID, 0, (INSTR(B.GROUP_ID, '|') - 1)) AND BGT_DGR = (SUBSTR(B.GROUP_ID, (INSTR(B.GROUP_ID, '|') + 1 ))) ) ELSE '' END AS GROUP_COL
FROM TB_COMMCD A , TB_COMMCDDETL B WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.CL_CD = A.CL_CD AND B.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND B.DETL_CD = #code#
AND B.DETL_CD <> #notCode#
AND A.CL_CD = #codeId# AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY DECODE(B.LINE_UP_ORD, NULL, 0, B.LINE_UP_ORD), B.DETL_CD
ORDER BY CASE WHEN INSTR(B.GROUP_ID, '|') > 0 THEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(B.GROUP_ID, 0, 4)) ELSE 9999 END DESC , CASE WHEN INSTR(B.GROUP_ID, '|') > 0 THEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(B.GROUP_ID, (INSTR(B.GROUP_ID, '|') + 1))) ELSE 0 END ASC , DECODE(B.LINE_UP_ORD, NULL, 0, B.LINE_UP_ORD), B.DETL_CD

/*BudgetCommCd.selectListAll*/ SELECT B.GROUP_ID AS GROUP_ID , B.DETL_CD , B.DETL_CD_NM , B.LINE_UP_ORD , B.USE_YN FROM TB_COMMCD A , TB_COMMCDDETL B WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.CL_CD = A.CL_CD AND A.CL_CD = #codeId# AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY DECODE(B.LINE_UP_ORD, NULL, 0, B.LINE_UP_ORD), B.DETL_CD
/*BudgetCommCd.selectMaxCd*/ SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(detl_cd AS NUMERIC(19, 0))), 0) FROM tb_commcddetl WHERE CL_CD = #codeId#
/*BudgetCommCd.selectCnt*/ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_commcddetl WHERE CL_CD = #clCd# AND DETL_CD = #detlCd#
sqlMap.insert: /*BudgetCommCd.insertCommCd*/ INSERT INTO tb_commcddetl ( cl_cd, detl_cd, group_id, detl_cd_nm, default_val_yn, line_up_ord, mng_item_val, use_yn, regi_id, regi_date ) VALUES ( #clCd#, #detlCd#, #groupId#, #detlCdNm#, #defaultValYn#, #lineUpOrd#, #mngItemVal#, #useYn#, #userId#, SYSTIMESTAMP );
sqlMap.update: /*BudgetCommCd.updateCommCd*/ UPDATE tb_commcddetl SET detl_cd_nm = #detlCdNm#, line_up_ord = #lineUpOrd#, use_yn = #useYn#, group_id = #groupId#, modi_id = #userId#, modi_date = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE CL_CD = #clCd# AND DETL_CD = #detlCd#
/*BudgetCommCd.updateCommCdUseYn*/ UPDATE tb_commcddetl SET use_yn = #useYn#, modi_id = #userId#, modi_date = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE CL_CD = #clCd# AND DETL_CD = #detlCd#
